title: Cat Plays With Owner in Cat Tunnel Tube
description:
Ace, the cat, was playing with his owner in a cat tunnel tube. When the man was peaking in it, he sneaked out and jumped on him. The cat hid in the tunnel while his owner looked for him in it.
